description:
List every website you can manage in ConsentEase (your own sites, plus — for agency accounts — your clients' sites). Cursor-paginated, newest first.

Args:
  - limit (number, optional): Page size, 1–100 (default 20 on the server).
  - cursor (string, optional): Opaque cursor from a previous page's "nextCursor".
  - domain (string, optional): Exact domain match, normalized like create_site (protocol/www/path removed, lowercase).
  - status (string, optional): pending, scanning, compliant or attention. Filters apply before cursor pagination; keep the same filters on every page.

Returns JSON: { "data": Site[], "nextCursor": string | null }. When "nextCursor" is null you have reached the last page; otherwise pass it back as "cursor" to fetch the next page.

Statuses are operational: pending = no completed scan yet; scanning = scan in progress; compliant = scan completed successfully, NOT legal compliance; attention = scan failed or needs review. scriptsFound is null (not measured in the stored website snapshot).
Use this first when you need a site's id, domain, or status before calling another tool. Requires scope: sites:read.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's nextCursor.

domain.description: Exact normalized domain; URLs with protocol/www/path are accepted.

status.description: Operational scan status, not a legal compliance verdict.

name: consentease_list_sites
title: List ConsentEase sites
